{{Top|leg}}
'''Pom seed flour''' was a type of [[Flour/Legends|flour]] made from [[pom]] seeds. It was used in the seasoning of [[Tip-yip/Legends|Endorian chicken]] wings and to make the crust for [[Endorian chicken pot pie]] and [[All-Almakian apple pie]] in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
